on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      quality_source_run_id:
        description: 'One-off image-only repair: 43578495558; empty runs every quality job'
        required: false
        default: ''
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

if: ${{ !cancelled() && ((inputs.quality_source_run_id == '' && needs.api-quality.result == 'success' && needs.web-quality.result == 'success' && needs.settings-quality.result == 'success' && needs.reading-performance-comparison.result == 'success') || (inputs.quality_source_run_id != '' && needs.api-quality.result == 'skipped' && needs.web-quality.result == 'skipped' && needs.settings-quality.result == 'skipped' && needs.reading-performance-comparison.result == 'skipped')) }}

steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: Image-only release policy negative controls
        if: ${{ inputs.quality_source_run_id != '' }}
        run: |
          python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci -p 'test_image_only_quality_reuse.py' -v
          node --test scripts/ci/*.test.mjs

      - name: Record verified release quality provenance
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          QUALITY_JOB_RESULTS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
          QUALITY_SOURCE_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.quality_source_run_id }}
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/ci/image-only-quality-reuse.py
          --source-run "$QUALITY_SOURCE_RUN_ID"
          --head "$GITHUB_SHA"
          --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/quality-verification.json"

      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@8d2750c68a42422c14e847fe6c8ac0403b4cbd6f # v3.12.0

retention-days: 3

      - name: Verify real ORM memory-control-plane status and source guards
        run: >-
          docker run --rm --env APP_ENV=test --env TEMP=/data
          chat-reader-api:${GITHUB_SHA}
          python -m unittest scripts.test_verify_small_zip_memory -v

      - name: Build Web image

- name: Inspect downloaded release archive independently
        working-directory: release-artifact

          set -euo pipefail
replacements.after:
- name: Inspect downloaded release archive independently
        working-directory: release-artifact
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          QUALITY_SOURCE_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.quality_source_run_id }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -s quality-verification.json
          python3 ../scripts/ci/image-only-quality-reuse.py \
            --source-run "$QUALITY_SOURCE_RUN_ID" --head "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --producer-attempt "$ARTIFACT_PRODUCER_ATTEMPT" \
            --verify-report quality-verification.json --manifest release-manifest.json \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/quality-verification-consumer.json"
